protocol.grammar: chain: midpoint(previous, earlier point) or foot(previous, distinct base pair); width alternates 3/4
protocol.rejection: undefined/duplicate specification or initial-point output only; never solver results
protocol.ablation: single most used summarized H, tie by content ID; all evaluation tasks
protocol.regression: original four tasks, excluded from fresh cohort
protocol.witness_channel: evaluator-only file; no file path or program supplied to solver
protocol.scientific_gate: no lost baseline/exposed solve; hidden objects; lower expansion/state/goal cost vs exposed; used-H causal ablation; exact replay
protocol.tuning: no task, seed, budget changes after mechanism evaluation
